decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several speakers across different price points and form factors. The consideration set included a rugged outdoor option (HyperGear), a retro wood design (INSMY), a well-known brand (JBL Renewed), a budget-friendly mini speaker (FLYSH), and a high-power portable option (Raymate). I ultimately chose the Raymate Bluetooth Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) because it offers the best combination of technical specifications—30W output and IPX7 waterproofing—with a very high average rating (4.6) at a very competitive $39.99 price point. While the JBL is a superior brand, being a renewed product with some reviews mentioning battery failure, the Raymate felt like a safer and more value-oriented purchase for a 30W device.
